```{r}
text <- c("Once upon a time, in a land that may or may not be far away from you as you read this, a beautiful and perfect baby boy was born. 

The boy being beautiful and perfect was the only good thing that would happen for a while. His father was a pretty fancy guy, and his wife and children lived in lavish luxury, waited on hand and foot by their loyal staff. Unfortunately, the beautiful and perfect little boy's mother was not the fancy wife, she was staff. (Staff who had been a bit too loyal, if you asked the wife.) No one acknowledged this but everyone knew, which put a bit of tension into the household. The husband and wife already had a son and a daughter (neither were beautiful nor perfect)  who were, for a time, too young to know why no one liked this little boy, but they trusted their parents and bullied the little boy daily in an act of solidarity.")

```
```{r}
text_df <- tibble(text = text)
```
```{r}
text_df <- text_df %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text)
```
```{r}
stop_words <- stop_words
```
```{r}
text_df <- text_df |> 
  anti_join(stop_words)

```
```{r}
text_count <- text_df |> 
  count(word, sort = TRUE) 
```
```{r}
text_count |> 
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  mutate(word = reorder(word, n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, word)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(y = NULL)
```
